summary.text: Missy Cerrato, listed by Ballotpedia as Melissa Cerrato, is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 151, having taken office on December 1, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Her career experience includes working as a nanny, Uber driver, elder caregiver, housekeeper, and Pennsylvania House of Representatives staff member.
In the 2023-2024 session, Cerrato was assigned to the Aging & Older Adult Services, Children & Youth, Human Services, and Tourism & Recreational Development committees.
